title: Rust exact leaf and cache efficiency checks
hypothesis: Exact leaf work avoidance and early cache depth gating improve completed-search latency; shared full-key tables may reduce duplicate worker work within bounded memory.

data.reuseDisclosure: CHECK only: constructed public boards and existing Rust unit/parity fixture domains 0xa5276000-0xa5277fff already opened by the original engine check. No new gameplay cohort, protected/final data, or strength evaluation.

metrics.primary: Bit-exact leaf and legal root-column values; descriptive paired wall and process CPU latency on identical constructed public roots
secondary: allocated table bytes, peak process RSS
five alternating-order repeats; microbenchmark CPU and search time
private gates 1,2,3; capacities 1024,16384,262144; shared/private tables at equal total entries; 1,2,4 workers
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: Report every repeat, median and min/max of paired ratios. Constructed roots are mechanics diagnostics; no game confidence interval or population claim.

passCriteria: Zero f64 value-bit, selected-action, event or trace mismatches on paired completed-depth checks and existing tests. Cache choices may change realized work, and bounded-work fallback parity is claimed only for identical cache configuration.
Retain exact leaf and early depth-gate changes when the five-repeat median completed-search speed ratio exceeds 1.03; otherwise record negative and retain as optional or revert.

Shared cache compares full keys under synchronized nonblocking access, has bounded allocation and decision/configuration scope, and never exposes an incomplete value; keep opt-in unless all measured configurations favor it.
Run Cargo release checks, native/TypeScript parity, research validation and web build/MDX/figure tests; disclose pre-existing missing historical artifacts.
gate.failureAction: Retain negative/partial measurements and reject exact failing configuration; open no cohort.
gate.passAction: Publish CHECK engineering result and reviewable PR only; no strength claim or automatic cloud run.

stopConditions: Stop on any semantic mismatch and investigate before timing that arm.
Stop individual benchmark process after 120 seconds; total benchmark budget 1800 seconds; record partial arms without silently changing configuration.

One benchmark process at a time, no agent builds/tests during timed batches; fixed 1/2/4 worker sweep, no nested pools. Host is an interactive macOS workstation without hard affinity/isolation; report timings as shared-host diagnostics, never exclusive-machine throughput.
Stop at 4 GiB requested engine memory; no system settings, cloud resources or new game seeds.
